content.text: Every preferred element is present. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full. 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all assets without Vendor consent (notice only, which is not a consent condition), and 13.3 carries the licence across such an assignment. 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent, with consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, so the walk-away trigger is absent. Two immaterial points short of ideal wording, noted only: the competitor bar in 24.2 is qualified by "without Customer's consent" rather than being absolute, and the not-unreasonably-withheld standard in 24.2 is framed around an assignee with adequate capability and financial standing. Neither is a fallback failure, so no redline.
